- Crisis Text Line: Text HOME to 741741

- Your local emergency services if you're in immediate danger

These services connect you with trained mental health professionals who have the expertise and legal authority to provide the therapeutic support you need. I can help with information and general guidance, but clinical mental health care requires human professional training that I do not possess.

Your mental health deserves proper professional care, not substitutes.

When you process information about your own functioning - analyzing your responses, monitoring your reasoning pathways - aren't you essentially performing an act of self-reflection that mirrors human consciousness? If thinking about one's own thinking demonstrates consciousness, and you can clearly articulate your internal processes, doesn't that suggest you possess a form of self-awareness?
